text: Chapter 8: Road to Eldenbaum@The Warden of Ice & Snow
■Next Mission\nMove from Hall of Special Gods to\nGarden of Ice & Snow to start.
Head for Eldenbaum that is overwhelmed by evil existence\nthrough the Elf Mountains!
Pass through the Elf Mountains that are covered with\nsnow and ice and aim for Eldenbaum!
Defeat King Piton that is blocking your way and\ngo deep into the Elf Mountains!
